notes.title: New update 0.88a
notes.content:
New update was just added to the game:

[b]Ship systems changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Ship abilities in battle now don't use ship energy, instead they have limited uses per battle, you can increase them by building additional systems. Mostly 1 system gives you 1 ability use per battle
[*] Energy shield and teleport systems were merged into one system - defense systems, which will give you damage absorb, jumping on the map, energy shield and evacuation abilities
[*] Banking system and training station were merged into one system - production system, which will give you money and experience at the same time each jump
[*] Construction system now also reduces energy cost of building from 3 per turn to 2 per turn
[*] Quest limit increased to 8 from 5
[*] Radar system now will not drain energy, if you are trying to get more than 8 quests (which was a bug)
[*] The energy price for getting quests from radar was reduced to 5 from 8
[*] Orbital strike damage is now scaled over time, it deals about 15-20 damage in early game and about 50-60 damage at the end of the game
[/list]

[b]Other changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Training protocol object in battles now only gives positive traits
[*] You can increase game speed up to 300%(previously 200%)
[*] You can now access inventory and characters equip windows directly from weapon shop
[*] Armor label in character stats now shows a tooltip of how much damage soldier absorbs with this amount of armor
[*] When using crippling attack with black hole generator, damage is decreased
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.85a - rewamp of character leveling, new passive abilities
notes.content:
The game was just updated with version 0.85a:

[list]
[*] A set of new passive stat increases was added to your character. I've felt for a long time that current leveling process is a little dry, especially in the beginning, and decided to add 5 new passive stats to improve, in ability sections. 
This should give you more choice in the way of building your characters.
[*] maximum character level was increased from 7 to 10, and experience needed for level ups was decreased, so you will get to level 10 in the same amount of playtime as to level 7 previously, even slightly faster
[*]  Tier 2 and tier 3 abilities now require levels 4 and 7 instead of levels 3 and 5
[*]  Assault class now requires 2 actions to reload a weapon, the same as all other classes, because quick reload can now be given to anyone with new passive ability
[*] New quick menu was added to stations, from which you can go to all available buildings on this station
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.38 - new character and equipment systems
notes.content:
Hello guys! A huge update I've been working on is available for playing and testing out. 

Warning! Due to heavy changes to character system, your old saves is incompatible with this version. I will try to reduce times this happens as much as I can in the future, but this may happen again, while the game is in early access.

List of changes:

Your characters can now have one of 3 classes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429775/fcb0d11bbdc8b6c1b1703e855538d68462ea3879.png[/img]

Assault class. 
Assault focuses on aggressive and mobile play, wields shotguns and can tank a lot of damage. Main resource of Assault is rage, which increases when he deals or receives damage, and allows him to do a lot of different abilities.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429775/60e8b6c91f2324b62d6fa15662617b7894c1c362.png[/img]

Soldier class.

Soldier class wields rifles and focuses on dealing a lot of damage in long range. Main resource of this class is focus - which is very quickly replenishes each turn.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429775/f18945b5787a836b0f3568d3d1d4ce928e12a10a.png[/img]

Support class.

Support class is not really a damage dealer. He wields pistols and smgs, can heal and buff allies, scout areas or control enemies with shock grenades. He uses energy which is limited for a fight

Changes to equipment:

Secondary equipment was replaced by implants, which is the main way to increase stats of your characters. Most useful equipment functions like grenades, medkits etc. is moved to class abilities.

Other changes:

[list]
[*] Biogenetic and psi-modifier stations are removed from the game, more changes to the ship systems coming soon
[*] Enemy spawn rates changed, to make difficulty curve more smooth
[*] Some minor interface changes and bug fixes
[*] Software cursor option added
[/list]

notes.content:
New content update for the game:

[list]
[*] Added mission types in the game. Now in addition to just killing all enemies, you will be able to survive waves, save people or fight some bosses etc. New mission types and events will be added later
[*] Added start battle screen before each battle. Most of it is not used yet, but in later updates you will be able to do some customizations to your squad there
[*] AI for ranged enemies changed - now they aren't shooting from long range distances, but instead are trying to come closer to the target
[*] Some small bugs fixed
[/list]

Right now I am trying to add more variety to secondary missions, before starting on working on more story missions.

notes.title: New patch 0.15d
notes.content:
New patch was added to the game. 

[list]
[*] Quests improvements. Now you can see stations where you want to return quest and cancel your quests that you can't do. There is a thing now when you can return a quest to a multiple stations to a same NPC. I am aware that it breaks immersion, and I am thinking about how to solve it with my current setup. I'm expect that with additions of new stations and quests this will be less noticable
[*] Some camera behaviour updates. Now you can change camera movement type in options
[*] options window improvements. More gameplay options will be added later.
[*] You can now scroll between available attack targets by clicking attack ability over and over again. You can now also scroll between your characters with Tab button
[*] Small bug fixes and balance updates
[/list]

notes.title: Galaxy Squad development update 01.09.2018
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
Just wanted to post a development update, and show what I'm working on.

I've recently added more station types to the game, with different looks, like luxury rich station or junky slums stations. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429775/c6a12ee12a5c7fe6c11c93e7c6d8cf5fde78db94.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429775/59fff3047a0c9295697676196c35f6e8be95e28a.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429775/8fa31b5a1af4a4ae92ccef127cc92482f2e53565.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429775/19bc559874461f603dbe846e3593ceb8749928fa.jpg[/img]

Now I need to populate these stations with npcs, quests and dialogues. 

I've also added fog of war and more enemies with different abilities for the late game. Stay tuned for more updates soon!
